purpose_context: When Kent submits items via WhatsApp or Obsidian inbox, the capture agent currently flattens everything into Vikunja todos — including calendar events that should be on Google Calendar, and aspirations/musings that should be journal entries. This mission adds explicit routing for calendar events (auto-scheduled via gog when complete; WhatsApp clarification loop when incomplete), routes aspirations to dated journal entries, and adds a Vikunja Someday destination for concrete-but-parked items. It also tightens the task rule so events and aspirations stop falling through it. This is a scoped slice of the #271 Felix-as-mirror epic and supersedes #324.
purpose_tldr: Stop the capture agent from creating useless Vikunja todos for calendar events and aspirations; route them to Google Calendar or the journal instead.
